title: Modular retention templates and automated evidence playbook for request data
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Provide a modular, policy-driven retention template system for prompts/responses/request logs/metrics plus a standardized automated evidence playbook that can produce compliance-ready export bundles for audits. The feature should make it simple for customers to pick or customize retention profiles (examples: GDPR-Short, HIPAA-Long, EU-Residency-Only), visualize effective retention per route/tenant, and produce signed evidence packages with metadata and provenance for auditors.

Scope:
- Authoring UI in Console for 'Retention Templates' (create, clone, compose).
- Template primitives: data classes (prompts, responses, request-metadata, logs, metrics), retention TTL, residency constraints, anonymization/transformation rules, and evidence rules (export cadence, bundle format, signatures).
- Template inheritance: org -> project -> route overrides with clear effective retention resolution and conflict warnings.
- Evidence playbook: on-demand and scheduled export that produces a time-bounded bundle (ndjson + manifest + signed hash) with redaction/audit-log artifacts, plus an export audit entry stored for 1 year.
- Backend APIs for enforcement (GET effective retention, PATCH route retention, POST export-run).

Out of scope (this ticket): deep storage lifecycle plumbing for every storage provider; we will surface the intent and produce export bundles but actual cross-region archival connectors are separate work (follow-up ENG tasks).

Principles and constraints:
- Templates should be composable and human-readable (avoid opaque rule blobs).
- Default templates shipped for common regimes but always opt-in for residents.
- Evidence must include cryptographic integrity (manifest + SHA256) and a human-friendly summary for auditors.

Deliverables:
- Console screens: Templates list, Template editor (JSON + visual), Effective retention inspector on route details, Exports UI with history.
- API: /v1/retention/templates, /v1/retention/effective?route=, /v1/retention/export-run.
- Backend: policy evaluation service, export bundler, signed manifest generator.
- Docs: PRD, API reference, compliance playbook guide for customers, migration guide for existing TTL rules.

Acceptance criteria (high level):
1) Admin can create/clone/assign a retention template from Console and assign it to an organization or route.
2) Effective retention calculation resolves inheritance and shows conflict rationale in UI.
3) Customer can run an on-demand evidence export for a time window; the result is a downloadable bundle with manifest, checksums, and a human summary.
4) Exports are logged and shown in Exports history with status and signed URL.
5) API endpoints exist and are covered by integration tests.
6) Security review completed before release.

Metrics to track: adoption rate of templates (per org), # of exports run, median time to bundle generation, number of conflict warnings surfaced, customer-reported audit readiness score (qualitative).
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create, clone, and assign a retention template from Console
Effective retention inspector shows resolved TTL, residency and transformation rules with rationale
On-demand evidence export produces downloadable bundle with manifest, SHA256 hashes, and readable summary
Export history shows audit entries and signed URLs; retention of export metadata follows policy
